purpose: Third-party ICC profiles (Windows/Adobe, never committed) that oracle_t1_lcms2 and wide_profiles compare against. Tests read them ONLY from <workspace corpus root>/icc_subdir, never from system directories or env-var paths.
root: the ONE workspace oracle corpus root of .config/oracle-corpus.toml (steward-owned): start at the workspace root (CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../..), walk up at most max-ancestors parents, first ancestor A where A/<search> is a directory; resolves from the edit tree and from round exports; no env-var paths
missing_profile: the case prints `NOT_PROVEN: <test> <case> reason=<corpus_convention_absent|corpus_root_absent|installed_profile_absent|profile_sha256_mismatch> ...` and returns without a verdict; with require_corpus true or env HSK_PRISM_REQUIRE_CORPUS=1 it fails instead
populate: python tests/oracle/populate_corpus.py [--from DIR]... [--root DIR] (stdlib only; READS the system profile directories named in t1_lcms2.json default_locations, copies only SHA-256-verified files into <corpus root>/icc_subdir, writes MANIFEST.json there; never builds or tests)
files: t1_lcms2.json profiles with origin=installed (name + SHA-256 recorded there)
